title: Kitten waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M26 46 L14 43' stroke='#e89a3a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <g>
